name: Mace MFG
old_description: In 2023, I took a leap of faith and founded Mace Manufacturing. My tinkering on nights and weekends began with 3D printers and CNC routers. This eventually evolved into acquiring a CNC plasma table to design and fabricate a replacement floor for my 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser. As most of you know, as we get older, our tools just get bigger and more expensive. In February of 2023, I decided to sell my dream car, which was a 1993 Nissan Skyline GTR, to purchase a HAAS VF2 and challenge myself to develop unique and innovative automotive machined accessories.
about:
Mace MFG is based in Indian Land, South Carolina, and was founded in 2023 by Stuart, a mechanical engineer with a background in automotive design and manufacturing. The venture began with nights-and-weekends tinkering using 3D printers and CNC routers, followed by a CNC plasma table to fabricate a replacement floor for a 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser. In February 2023, the founder sold a 1993 Nissan Skyline GT-R to purchase a HAAS VF2 vertical machining center and focus on developing machined automotive accessories.

The company produces precision CNC-machined accessories for off-road Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Its product line includes billet aluminum volume knobs, titanium-and-Ultem key fob cases, polycarbonate-and-Ultem key fob cases, battery tie-downs, shift knobs, drive-mode knobs, front bump stops, rail T-nuts, and battery clamp J-hooks. Manufacturing is centered on the HAAS VF2, supplemented by earlier capabilities in CNC routing, 3D printing, and plasma cutting. Materials used are 6061 aluminum, titanium, Ultem (PEI), and polycarbonate.

Mace MFG serves the automotive aftermarket and overlanding communities, targeting owners of Toyota 4Runner, Tundra, Tacoma, Sequoia, and Lexus GX, LX, and FJ Cruiser models. Sales are direct-to-consumer through the company’s e-commerce site, which offers model-specific fitment. The site also highlights collaborations with other independent makers such as Charvonia Design, Perry Parts, and Teton Workshop.

The business was started to create unique, innovative machined accessories that combine American-made quality with adventurous design. The founder emphasizes engineering-driven development, scrutinizing every detail to deliver rugged gear with reliable performance and no compromise on quality.
